thermal_paths.interface_material: Wakefield 120-5 thermal joint compound, 0.001 inch film
thermal_paths.review_note: Wakefield lists 36 C rise at 15 W in natural convection and 0.9 C/W at 250 LFM for the 641K, plus 0.05 C/W for a one-square-inch 0.001-inch 120-series compound film. The 118 J/C sink heat capacity is the conservative reviewed product of the catalog 0.290 lb aluminum mass and 897 J/(kg C) aluminum specific heat; dynamic evaluation retains the intrinsic package stage separately and applies airflow events only to this assembly stage.
